counterfactual_missing_items: No raw evidence of LVAD thrombosis such as thrombus, hemolysis, or pump failure
No raw evidence of cardiac allograft dysfunction such as reduced LVEF or hemodynamic compromise
No raw evidence of rejection or infection
decisive_items: occupied almost the entire left hemithorax
response.rationale: R6 is directly supported by serial post-transplant CT findings showing the cardiac allograft compressing the left bronchus and occupying the left hemithorax, with subsequent relief as the allograft remodels. R1 captures the remodeling but labels it dysfunction without raw evidence of impaired function. R4 refers to pre-transplant LVAD history and does not explain the post-transplant imaging findings.

rejected.why: Spans only document pre-transplant LVAD and pump exchanges; no raw evidence of thrombus or pump failure in the post-transplant course.
